title: CABAL: Revolution opens free-to-play CBT from Nov. 5 to 17, invites players to test skills in rebalanced version
summary: Combo InterActive announces the opening of CABAL: Revolution’s new version for players to experience through the Closed Beta Test (CBT), running 5 – 17 November 2026. Everyone can join the CBT…

blocks.text: Combo InterActive announces the opening of CABAL: Revolution’s new version for players to experience through the Closed Beta Test (CBT), running 5 – 17 November 2026. Everyone can join the CBT for free, with no ID purchase required, to try out the game, inviting CABAL players from across Southeast Asia (SEA) to join the adventure and test their skills on the same battlefield.

This return isn’t just about nostalgia; it’s an opportunity for players of every class to rediscover their playstyle, from a major class rebalance to overhauled combat, gear, and reward systems, bringing fresh excitement to leveling, character progression, and player competition.
Rebalance across all 9 classes: When your old playstyle may no longer be the answer

The highlight of CABAL: Revolution is a major Rebalance covering all 9 classes, aimed at making each class’s strengths and playstyle more compelling. Veteran players now have a reason to revisit familiar combos and strategies, while new players can start fresh and find the class that suits them best in this version.

Beyond the Rebalance, there’s also an expanded combat system, improvements to gear and equipment, and the in-game reward system all part of elevating the gameplay experience, which players can experience firsthand during CBT.
ALZ at the heart of the game’s economy: play, farm, and progress

CABAL: Revolution positions ALZ as the core currency of the in-game economy, serving as the central medium for farming and trading through gameplay, while the currency system is now more clearly defined, with Force Gem used in the Agent Shop and tradable between players at a 1:1 rate, reflecting the intended direction where in-game play and resource accumulation still carry meaning.
Heating up every week! Mission war and guild ranking with rewards

PvP and guild-focused players have another reason to rally their teams for competitive activities like Mission War, with rewards worth 100 USD per week, and the Weekly Guild Ranking with a total reward pool worth 300 USD per week — plus many more activities being prepared for players to join. Full rules and event schedules can be followed via the game’s official channels.
Free CBT access, 5 – 17 November! Try it before choosing your path to OBT

During CBT from 5 – 17 November 2026, players can try CABAL: Revolution for free with no ID purchase required for this test. Whether you’re a veteran wanting to experience the changes, or a new player wanting to start out in the CABAL world, you can use this period to explore the systems and pick your favorite class before deciding to buy OBT access.
Please note: Free CBT participation and Open Beta Test (OBT) access are separate, OBT will require an ID purchased according to the designated sales rounds.
Early bird sale phase 2 at US$29: Reserve OBT access before the price goes up

Alongside the CBT launch on 5 November 2026, CABAL: Revolution opens Early Bird Sale Phase 2 at just 29 USD per ID, limited to 100,000 IDs for OBT access, before the Regular Sale round on 19 November 2026 at 11:00 AM, which will sell at 49 USD per ID, limited to 200,000 IDs.

Players who choose Early Bird Phase 2 will save 20 USD per ID compared to the Regular price, roughly 41% off the Regular price, and lock in the special price within the designated ID quota. It’s an opportunity for players who’ve tried CBT and like the direction of the new version, and want to prepare ahead for the OBT launch.

CBT is free to play 5 – 17 November, no ID purchase needed to try it, while Early Bird at 29 USD is a purchase of OBT access, not a CBT entry fee. The OBT opening date and further details will be announced through official channels.
